subject: Request: Deferred credit & temporary throughput priority for ZenOpt incident
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@zenopt.ai>
To: support@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Major latency spike this morning — request for remediation

Hi team,

We saw sustained tail-latency >3s on our inference routes between 03:40-04:10 PT this morning which impacted production traffic for two of our customer-facing features. We've attached a short timeline and a sample trace. Our ops and SREs had to route traffic to our fallback path which increased cost and degraded UX for about 45 minutes.

Can you confirm what happened and what remedial credit you can provide? Our renewal is up in Q3 and this is a material concern for our customers.

—Alex
VP Engineering, ZenOpt

Attachment: zenopt-incident-timeline.pdf (pdf)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@zenopt.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Major latency spike this morning — request for remediation

Alex — thanks for the note and the timeline. I'm sorry for the disruption. We've spoken to Ops and the initial cause looks like an autoscaling edge case combined with a transient kernel thrash on the serving fleet. Ops is preparing a full RCA; I'll share that when it's ready.

Short-term offer so you can reply to your execs quickly:
- One month of platform credits equal to ZenOpt's average monthly spend (to offset the cost of failover)
- A deferred-credit schedule (2 tranches of 50%) that you'd apply across Q3/Q4 invoicing
- Temporary throughput priority for the critical inference route for 72 hours while you roll forward fixes (no extra charge)

Before I send anything formal I need internal approval for the value and signoff path. Looping in Karthik to advise on exec approval route.

Hannah
Director, Account Escalations
Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Major latency spike this morning — request for remediation

Hannah — thanks, this sounds reasonable. Quick notes for approval path:
- One month credit at invoice value is fine under manager approval up to $50k. Anything above requires commercial exec signoff.
- Deferred schedule (2x50%) is operationally simple and limits immediate revenue impact.
- Throughput priority for 72h: ops can flag it as a temporary policy change; we should include a rollback window.

Marissa — can you sign off on up to $50k credit + the temporary priority? If you want to escalate to Jonas for >$50k, please advise.

Karthik
Head of Sales Operations
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Major latency spike this morning — request for remediation

Thanks for the context. I reviewed ZenOpt's account history and the ARR band. Approve manager-level concession:
- One month credit capped at $48,000 (matches their average monthly invoice)
- Deferred credit schedule: two equal tranches to be applied 2026-08 and 2026-11 invoices
- Approve temporary throughput priority for 72 hours; Ops to implement and confirm rollback plan

If ZenOpt asks for anything beyond the above (e.g., multi-quarter credits or SOW changes) escalate to Jonas for exec approval. Hannah — please prepare a concise external offer and ask for written acknowledgement.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success (EMEA & Strategic Accounts)
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@zenopt.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed remediation credit & short-term priority for ZenOpt (formal offer)

Alex — following our review and internal approval, here's the formal offer to resolve the incident while we complete the RCA: 

Offer summary (please reply to acknowledge):
- One month platform credit equal to $48,000 applied to your next invoice.
- Deferred-credit schedule: $24,000 applied to 2026-08 invoice and $24,000 applied to 2026-11 invoice (no cash transfer).
- Temporary throughput priority on your critical inference route for 72 hours starting at 08:00 PT on Thu, Jun 24 — our Ops team will confirm the window and rollback plan 1 hour before start.
- We will deliver a full RCA and remediation timeline within 5 business days.

Next steps:
1) Reply to confirm acceptance of the credit schedule and priority window.
2) If accepted, we'll issue a credit memo and provide a DocuSign link for an acknowledgement (link: https://redwood.app/docusign/ZN-3421-credit-agreement).

Thanks again for raising this promptly. We're committed to making this right and supporting your Q3 renewal discussions.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Account Escalations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-deferred-credit-schedule.xlsx (xlsx)
